title: Hopper FP8 profile robustness and automated calibration
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Enable and harden FP8 quantization profiles (E4M3 and E5M2) for Hopper-class GPUs in the inference runtime. This ticket covers: a deterministic profile selection mechanism that picks E4M3 vs E5M2 per-model and per-input distribution, an automated calibration pipeline that produces stable per-layer scale/exponent parameters from production-like calibration sets, numeric stability fixes observed in long-sequence KV cache behavior and prefix caching, and rollout controls with automated fallback to INT8 when quality or stability thresholds are breached.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Operator can generate an FP8 calibration bundle for any model using the calib CLI and upload it to the model registry. 2) The runtime chooses E4M3 or E5M2 automatically using the selection policy and logs decision+score to telemetry. 3) Regression vs FP32 is within thresholds: <=0.5% relative metric loss on generative evals and <=1.0% on classification across a validation suite of 20 prompts per model. 4) No crashes or NaN propagation after 48h of production-like replay on canary capacity. 5) If runtime detects persistent overflow/saturation or accuracy regression > thresholds, it automatically falls back to INT8 or FP16 and emits an alert and rollback reason into the console.
implementation_notes: Approach: 1) Calibration automation: expand calib pipeline to support multi-pass histogram collection, per-layer exponent smoothing, and stratified sampling of user prompt types. 2) Profile selection: compute a stability score combining activation dynamic range, exponent entropy, and saturation counters; low score prefers E4M3 for margin, otherwise E5M2 for density. 3) Stability fixes: clip-and-scale adjustments for KV accumulation, compensated accumulation on attention softmax for seq_len>2048, and per-kernel guardrails to clear cache slots when overflow trends appear. 4) Rollout: canary on dedicated Hopper pool, gradual ramp with telemetry gates, and automated fallback policy integrated into route config. 5) Telemetry: record per-request profile_version, selected_format, per-layer saturation events, scale drift, and sample outputs for diffing against FP32 baseline.
testing_plan: Unit tests for exponent selection and smoothing logic. HW tests on H100 and emulated stacks: run the 12-model bench (NMT, summarization, chat, classification) with 1000 calibration examples each. Calibration reproducibility test must produce per-layer scales within 2% across 5 runs. End-to-end: canary on dedicated Hopper pool for 72h with synthetic traffic + 1% production shadow replay. Regression dashboards for BLEU/ROUGE/ExactMatch and tail-latency 95/99. Smoke tests: force saturations to verify fallback and alerting.
notes: Spike found E5M2 exponent packing shows high variance for narrow intermediate distributions on some decoder-only models with rotary embeddings and long prefixes; moving-average exponent damping reduced NaN rate ~85% in spike tests. Added a temporary toggle to prefer E4M3 per-route until damping thresholds are tuned. Ops should monitor per-route FP8 failure rates and ensure dedicated capacity autoscaler does not throttle canary traffic. Follow-up: extend calibration to quant-aware distillation export for model providers.
updates: 2026-02-20: Initial spike completed - found per-layer scaling instability on E5M2 with long sequence lengths and rotary embeddings.
2026-02-28: Implemented adaptive exponent blending between E4M3 and E5M2; added saturation detection telemetry and a canary-only opt-in route flag.
2026-03-05: End-to-end validation across 6 representative models shows <=0.4% generative metric regressions and stable numeric behavior; preparing canary rollout instructions and runtime gates.
